title: EgMM-Corpus: A Multimodal Vision-Language Dataset for Egyptian Culture

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the zero-shot classification and cross-modal retrieval (Image-to-Text and Text-to-Image) performance of the CLIP vision-language model on EgMM-Corpus, a newly curated dataset specifically representing Egyptian cultural concepts like landmarks, food, and folklore.

Analyzing per-concept zero-shot performance gaps in CLIP to demonstrate lower recognition accuracy for locally-known Egyptian sites compared to internationally recognized or Western-centric landmarks.
Observing performance disparities where the vision-language model fails to recognize cultural sites that are primarily documented in Arabic-language sources or specialized heritage databases.
